en.name: Bowei Xu
en.title: Business Systems & Backend Engineer
en.bio: I'm the entire IT department at a fuel cell and renewable energy company. I own the systems that take orders, run the shop floor, and tell the business what to buy next. ERP, WMS, MES, e-commerce, and the data layer connecting them: a 50+ table schema and a 100,000+ line codebase, in production, built and run by one person.
